description.value: Jaide & Joel's Baking Co is a fully dedicated vegan and gluten-free bakery and café in Kelowna's Rutland neighbourhood, offering fresh-baked donuts, loaves, scones, cakes, and freshly brewed organic coffee daily with no pre-ordering required. The shop prides itself on zero taste compromise for dietary restrictions, and also handles custom celebration cakes for events. Complimentary parking is available in the lot behind the building, and DoorDash delivery is available for those not stopping in.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the business is a 100% vegan and gluten-free bakery/café at 101-555 Montgomery Road, Kelowna, matching OSM tags diet:vegan=only and diet:gluten_free=only. The website confirms online ordering and DoorDash pickup/delivery, supporting a Takeout value of true. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging appears anywhere in the website content, so those fields are null. OSM opening hours conflict with website hours (OSM shows Monday open 09:00-17:00; website shows Monday closed and weekday close at 16:00, not 17:00), flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag (Mo-Fr 09:00-17:00; Sa,Su 10:00-16:00) conflicts with website hours (Monday CLOSED; Tue-Fri 09:00-16:00; Sat 10:00-16:00; Sun 10:00-15:00). OSM should be updated to reflect Monday closure and correct weekday/Sunday close times.
OSM address field omits unit number (101); website and OSM addr:unit tag both confirm the full address is 101-555 Montgomery Road.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible bakery and café with a confirmed website, address, and phone. A useful stop for touring cyclists, particularly those with vegan or gluten-free dietary needs.
